claim_level: exact divisor computation; no rational-point search used

fermigier_E22.definition: Rows encode div(g_i) modulo 2.  Irreducible QQ factors are closed branch places of geometric weight equal to their degree; infinity is included when it has odd valuation.

geometric_incidence_code_automorphisms.meaning: Product of symmetric groups on geometric branch places with the same binary incidence column.  This is a code automorphism count only; it does not assert that these permutations are induced by PGL_2 or by automorphisms of the cover.

multiquadratic_cover.genus_formula: 1 + 2^(r-2)*(B-4) for a connected (Z/2)^r cover of P1, where r is code dimension and B is the branch-union size
